messages:
Ellen (PM): Quick sync before tomorrow's GA cut: still outstanding - SLA credit formula, fallback policy for Dedicated overloads, docs rollback steps, monitoring suppressions, and pricing SKUs. Who picks up which?
Raj (Eng): I can finalize fallback behavior options and add a tiny SDK/curl snippet for docs.
Marta (SRE): I'll take monitoring suppressions and the smoke-run checklist. Planning suppression: first 15m=info, 15-60m=warning, >60m=alert.
Ken (Legal): SLA: we want a clear credit calc + exclusions (maintenance, <5m transient glitches). I'll draft language but need product consent on max cap.
Fiona (Finance): Pricing SKUs: proposal = hosted.generate.standard, hosted.generate.burst, dedicated.reserved.hour. Promo idea = PROMO-GA-10 (3mo 10% off) opt-in.
Priya (Docs): Docs needs a 5-step rollback and an example handling 429. Can Eng paste bullets + snippet?
Raj (Eng): Rollback bullets draft:
1) Flip routing to fallback-model (10s grace)
2) Drain new requests from affected pool
3) Add capacity from reserved pool or spin a node
4) Invalidate KV cache if suspect
5) Run smoke tests and revert routing when healthy
Priya (Docs): Nice. Can you also give a tiny curl + python SDK example for quickstart?
Raj (Eng): Sure:
```
# curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"instruct-v1","input":"Hi","max_tokens":50}'

# python
from redwood import Redwood
r = Redwood(api_key="$KEY")
resp = r.generate(model="instruct-v1", input="Hi")
print(resp.text)
```
Samir (Support): Support playbook ask: add billing-dispute flow + how to request temporary burst. Priors from pilots: customers want soft-fallback by default.
Fiona (Finance): Finance prefers fallback only if customer opts in (opt-in simplifies billing). We can enable promo only when account flag set.
Ken (Legal): Legally prefer default=reject (429) and opt-in addendum enabling soft-fallback. I'll draft addendum and consent wording.
Ellen (PM): Decision: default = reject with 429 + clear upgrade/reserve link. Soft-fallback available behind opt-in addendum. Action owners: Ken (addendum), Fiona (promo & billing flag), Raj (snippets + rollback), Marta (monitoring + smoke), Priya (docs), Samir (support templates).
ReleaseBot: Deploy window scheduled 2026-04-10T07:00:00Z. CI status: unit=pass, e2e=pass, perf=running.
Marta (SRE): Smoke run invite sent for 2026-04-10T06:30Z. We'll exercise fallback route and page test oncall.
Priya (Docs): ETA for legal redlines and promo flag? I need those before merge.
Ken (Legal): I'll send redlines in ~2h; cap liability language simple: cap = greater of $50k or 1 month's fees, whichever is lower.
Fiona (Finance): I'll wire the billing flag and create PROMO-GA-10 as opt-in. Posting SKU mapping in 45m.
Raj (Eng): Perf job green locally; if upstream perf CI flakes we delay deploy by 1h.
Samir (Support): I'll draft outage notification + credits flow and post here.
Ellen (PM): Perfect. If Legal + Finance finalize today and perf CI is green, we proceed with GA tomorrow. Post blockers here. :white_check_mark:
